choice_clauses.statement: Physical line breaks also include CRLF, bare CR, U+2028, and U+2029
choice_clauses.source: choice: use the ECMAScript line-terminator set, with CRLF counted as one break, to accept text from different environments

choice_clauses.statement: The first equals sign separates the key from the full field value
choice_clauses.source: choice: keep the entire value available to its field's validation so a suffix cannot be discarded silently

choice_clauses.statement: Leading, repeated, or trailing semicolons introduce an empty field
choice_clauses.source: choice: interpret the delimiter as a separator so blank field fragments receive the same error as other fields without an equals sign

choice_clauses.statement: Trimming and judging blank lines use the same whitespace definition
choice_clauses.source: choice: use Node.js string whitespace semantics consistently for values and blanks

choice_clauses.statement: Surrounding whitespace on a field key is accepted
choice_clauses.source: choice: accept harmless spacing around the key–value separator

choice_clauses.statement: Field names use the listed case-sensitive spellings
choice_clauses.source: choice: use the five spellings given for the input schema, with case normalization reserved for status values

choice_clauses.statement: Named fields can appear in any order
choice_clauses.source: choice: the keys identify fields without imposing a position on callers

choice_clauses.statement: Omitting any expected key makes a record a syntax error
choice_clauses.source: choice: treat the listed keys as the record schema so absent fields and present empty values remain distinguishable

choice_clauses.statement: A field outside the expected schema makes a record a syntax error
choice_clauses.source: choice: surface misspellings and unsupported data instead of silently dropping a submitted field

choice_clauses.statement: Repeating any key within one record makes that record a syntax error
choice_clauses.source: choice: reject ambiguous record definitions without picking a field by position

choice_clauses.statement: Numeric field text uses full-string ECMAScript Number conversion for nonempty values
choice_clauses.source: choice: accept numeric spellings the runtime can read in full without a special decimal spelling requirement or silent acceptance of a numeric prefix

choice_clauses.statement: An ID without a finite numeric value throws SyntaxError
choice_clauses.source: choice: the request requires a numeric ID and assigns range errors specifically to quantity and price

choice_clauses.statement: Finite IDs have no sign or whole-number restriction
choice_clauses.source: choice: apply the request's whole-number and minimum rules only to qty and price

choice_clauses.statement: Empty text in a numeric quantity or price field is invalid
choice_clauses.source: choice: an empty value supplies no quantity or cents even though ECMAScript Number conversion of an empty string yields zero

choice_clauses.statement: Whole-number validation uses the numeric value produced by conversion
choice_clauses.source: choice: use ECMAScript binary64 Number semantics, whose largest safe integer is `9,007,199,254,740,991`, without adding a smaller application ceiling

choice_clauses.statement: Date validation uses the stated shape as the complete test for a nonempty date
choice_clauses.source: choice: the request specifies a textual date shape and leaves calendar validity open

choice_clauses.statement: With invalid records on multiple lines, the earliest failing line is reported
choice_clauses.source: choice: match the order in which the importer encounters records

choice_clauses.statement: A line with multiple violations can report any one of its applicable violations
choice_clauses.source: choice: the request assigns each rule an error type while leaving precedence inside a single line open

choice_clauses.statement: Total accepts arrays of orders with valid numeric quantities and prices
choice_clauses.source: choice: support array inputs with the two values used by the calculation without requiring caller metadata or specifying an error protocol for unsupported inputs

choice_clauses.statement: The cents calculation follows JavaScript Number arithmetic in array order
choice_clauses.source: choice: use the runtime's numeric multiplication and addition for the requested sum without introducing an overflow error or another return type
